findings.title: DMARC not enforced (p=none): domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud

evidence.excerpt: DMARC record: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@brightwaterfleet.example; policy=none, pct=100, rua=true

findings.deal_impact: Domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud against customers and deal counterparties; raises phishing and fraud risk for a fleet SaaS handling customer communications.

remediation.summary: Move DMARC to quarantine then reject, monitoring rua reports and aligning SPF/DKIM first.

findings.title: SPF uses soft/neutral fail

evidence.excerpt: SPF record: v=spf1 include:_spf.mailhost.example include:sendgrid.example ~all; qualifier=~all, lookup_count=2

findings.deal_impact: Softfail weakens sender authentication and spoofing resistance, compounding DMARC non-enforcement for deal and customer email trust.

remediation.summary: Inventory legitimate senders and change SPF qualifier to -all after DMARC alignment checks.

findings.title: DNSSEC not enabled

evidence.excerpt: DNSSEC enabled=false on DS query for brightwaterfleet.example

findings.deal_impact: Unsigned DNS increases cache-poisoning/redirection risk, though impact is limited compared to email and appliance findings; relevant to insurer hygiene checks.

remediation.summary: Enable DNSSEC at registrar/DNS provider and verify DS publication and validation.

findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: Risky hostname pattern=vpn, first_seen=2023-02-11, last_seen=2026-09-30; risky_hostnames_count=4

findings.deal_impact: Publicly logged vpn, legacy, staging and old Jenkins names suggest exposed attack surface to validate pre-close; may indicate legacy systems with weaker controls.

remediation.summary: Inventory, access-test and retire or restrict risky hosts; confirm VPN/Jenkins/staging/legacy are authenticated and patched.

findings.title: Large certificate footprint relative to company size
findings.deal_impact: 47 hostnames suggest surface sprawl relative to company size, increasing chance of forgotten assets; requires asset-inventory diligence rather than immediate value adjustment.

remediation.summary: Reconcile CT hostnames to asset inventory, remove orphaned certificates/hosts and implement continuous external monitoring.

findings.title: Deprecated TLS versions offered

evidence.excerpt: tls_support TLSv1.0=true, TLSv1.1=true, TLSv1.2=true; tls_versions=[TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1, TLSv1.2]

findings.deal_impact: Deprecated TLS on www weakens transport security and compliance posture for customer-facing fleet data, though apex uses TLSv1.3 only.

remediation.summary: Disable TLSv1.0/1.1 on www, enforce TLSv1.2+ with modern ciphers and retest all hosts.

findings.title: HSTS not set
findings.deal_impact: Missing HSTS allows downgrade to HTTP on first visit, a minor hygiene gap that insurers and customer security reviews commonly flag.

remediation.summary: Add Strict-Transport-Security header with appropriate max-age after confirming HTTPS coverage, then consider preload.

findings.title: Internet-facing appliance listed in CISA KEV (version not verified)

evidence.excerpt: KEV match CVE-PLACEHOLDER-0001 ExampleGate SSL-VPN version 7.0.11, match_tier=appliance_exposed, match_level=product; note: KEV lists products, not affected versions; version not verified. Potential exposure only.
Fingerprint product=ExampleGate SSL-VPN, version=7.0.11, kind=appliance, source=asset_path

findings.deal_impact: Potential exposure of an internet-facing SSL-VPN appliance listed in CISA KEV (version not verified) could enable network access if unpatched; prioritize validation as a closing diligence item.

remediation.summary: Immediately verify ExampleGate SSL-VPN patch level against KEV, patch/isolate if affected, and check for compromise indicators.

findings.title: Publicly disclosed security incident in the last 24 months

evidence.excerpt: State AG breach notice 2025-08-14: Notice filed for unauthorized access to a customer support system; approx. 3,100 individuals notified. Entity match exact; disclosed_within_months=14

findings.deal_impact: Incident disclosed 14 months ago involving customer support data may affect customer trust, regulatory exposure, cyber insurance and retention; diligence should review root cause and remediation closure.

remediation.summary: Obtain incident report, regulator closure status and remediation evidence; confirm support-system controls and notification obligations are closed.
